title: Apparel PoS Hub
subtitle: Progress, screens, architecture and decisions for the shop billing system.
demoNote: Demo: run flutter run -d chrome in apps/pos_windows, click Add practice users (this also adds demo stock and made-up GST details in development builds: GST on, a test shop GSTIN, HSN codes, jeans at their own 12%), then sign in (practice owner and practice cashier). The browser preview is for development only (data is lost on reload, nothing is encrypted or backed up, not for the shop). It covers sign-in, stock entry, the register, returns, pay later, markdowns, shifts and the blind close, the daily report, analytics, staff, categories and the GST reports; encryption, backups and the installer exist only on Windows and have not been run on a real Windows machine.
